### [Measuring how AI agents handle everyday wet-lab science](https://openai.com/index/measuring-how-ai-agents-handle-wet-lab-science)

**OpenAI** · 2026-11-06

OpenAI has introduced BioBasicsBench, a new benchmark featuring 100 tasks designed to evaluate how AI agents interpret raw experimental data and manage everyday wet-lab science operations.

- BioBasicsBench contains 100 distinct evaluation tasks.
- Measures AI agent performance on raw experimental data interpretation.
- Assesses capabilities in handling routine wet-lab science workflows.

**Why it matters:** It provides a standardized method to quantify how effectively AI agents can assist with or automate routine biological laboratory tasks.

### [Partnering with Hacktron to find vulnerabilities in OpenAI’s systems](https://openai.com/index/partnering-with-hacktron)

**OpenAI** · 2026-11-06

OpenAI is partnering with security firm Hacktron to identify system vulnerabilities, test third-party service connections, and enhance defenses using frontier AI.

- Partnership focuses on identifying vulnerabilities across OpenAI systems.
- Testing includes evaluating security and connections with third-party services.
- Frontier AI models will be utilized to strengthen overall system defenses.

**Why it matters:** Collaborating with external security experts helps secure third-party integrations and proactively harden AI infrastructure against potential exploits.
